name: dsh-task-management
description: DSH decisions and durable task/remote execution suite with optional channel adapters

scripts.build: npm run build -w @dsh-task/task-system && npm run build -w @dsh-task/feishu-channel
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:native && npm run test:legacy && npm run test:management
scripts.test:native: node --test tests/dsh/native-loader.test.mjs tests/dsh/remote-native.test.mjs tests/dsh/trusted-network-native.test.mjs tests/dsh/context-contract.test.mjs tests/dsh/pre-dispatch.test.mjs tests/dsh/executor-switch.test.mjs tests/dsh/project-executor.test.mjs tests/dsh/jev-native.test.mjs
scripts.test:legacy: node --test tests/legacy/readers.test.mjs tests/legacy/reporting.test.mjs tests/legacy/quota.test.mjs tests/legacy/compatibility.test.mjs tests/legacy/configured-sources.test.mjs tests/legacy/ad-hoc.test.mjs tests/legacy/diagnostics.test.mjs tests/legacy/context-contract.test.mjs
scripts.test:settings:official: node --expose-internals tests/settings/official-settings-smoke.mjs && node tests/settings/staged-form-smoke.mjs && node --expose-internals tests/settings/official-startup-smoke.mjs && node tests/settings/remote-snapshot-smoke.mjs && node --expose-internals tests/settings/disabled-remote-config-editor.mjs
